subject: Tenant environment certification & access handoff — NovusBio
content:
From: Eliot Kramer <ekramer@novusbio.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: NovusBio Infra <infra@novusbio.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 17:02:00 -0800
Subject: Tenant environment certification & access handoff — NovusBio

Hi David —

Thanks for the onboarding call earlier. Per our discussion, we're ready to start the certification sweep for the NovusBio private deployment. I'm attaching a first-pass network inventory and our SOC excerpt for your records.

Quick notes:
- We plan to own the bastion and key rotation internally.
- Requested smoke window: target the week of Jan 18; we can do Jan 20 morning (PST).
- Point people: myself (ekramer@novusbio.com) and Danielle (d.price@novusbio.com).

Attachments: novusbio_network_inventory.csv (csv), novusbio_certificate_of_compliance.pdf (pdf)

Could you confirm Redwood's exact validation checklist and any evidence format you need? Also we'll need the IP allowlist and test IPs from your side.

Thanks,
Eliot Kramer
Director of Infrastructure
NovusBio

---

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Eliot Kramer <ekramer@novusbio.com>
Cc: NovusBio Infra <infra@novusbio.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 16 Jan 2027 09:14:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Tenant environment certification & access handoff — NovusBio

Eliot —

Appreciate the inventory and SOC excerpt. We've reviewed the files and I've attached Redwood's onboarding checklist (v1) to align expectations. High-level asks from our side before we run the environment validation:

1) Network: VPC CIDR(s), subnets for control plane, compute, and bastion; any overlapping addresses we should know about.
2) Peering / routing: do you want a direct VPC peering, transit gateway, or a VPN? If BGP is used please provide ASN and route filters.
3) IP allowlist: list of egress IPs we should permit for healthchecks and telemetry.
4) KMS: confirm if you will trust Redwood's principal for envelope encryption or if you require our key to be wrapped by your KMS. Please send the KMS policy/ARN.
5) Time sync: hosts must allow NTP to Redwood test IPs; provide your NTP endpoint if you use an internal one.
6) Bastion: public key (if you want us to provision or test access) and owner on your side.

We also need a named contact for EDR/AV verification so our security engineer can coordinate.

Proposed next steps:
- You send the VPC diagram, ip allowlist, KMS policy, and bastion pubkey.
- We run a preflight connectivity check (no customer traffic) and provide a findings artifact.
- After fixes, we schedule the smoke test (30–60 minutes).

Attachments: redwood_onboarding_checklist_v1.xlsx (xlsx)

Let us know if Jan 20 AM PST is still possible.

Thanks —
David Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Eliot Kramer <ekramer@novusbio.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, NovusBio Infra <infra@novusbio.com>
Date: Sat, 16 Jan 2027 11:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Tenant environment certification & access handoff — NovusBio

Hi Eliot —

Adding a short evidence checklist to keep the run deterministic. Please provide the items below in the next 48 hours where possible so our security/compliance team can begin verification: 

Required evidence for preflight acceptance:
- VPC diagram (PNG/PDF) with annotated CIDRs and subnets.
- Routing matrix (what routes exist between subnets and to the internet).
- IP allowlist (plain text) for any firewall/NAT appliances.
- KMS policy or IAM role document (JSON) describing who can wrap/unwrap keys.
- Bastion owner and public SSH key (if bastion is customer-owned).
- EDR/AV contact and a sample log or confirmation that the agent is in place and reporting.
- Service account intended for Redwood agent (name + minimal IAM policy).
- Expected maintenance windows / blackout periods for the smoke run.

Validation steps we will perform (examples):
- TCP/UDP port sweep to confirm control-plane endpoints are reachable.
- TLS handshake verification for exposed endpoints and certificate chain check.
- NTP/time skew check and KV cache persistence test.
- KMS envelope encrypt/decrypt smoke to validate key permissions.
- Simulated 1k token traffic to exercise batching and KV cache paths (no real customer data).

Optional but helpful: a brief runbook (1–2 pages) describing your incident contact chain and escalation window. I'm attaching a minimal evidence template to make formatting easier.

Attachments: minimal-evidence-template.md (md)

If you can drop the items above, we'll triage and confirm a hard smoke window. If Jan 20 AM PST is tight, propose an alternative and we'll compress validation where feasible.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference

---

From: Danielle Price <d.price@novusbio.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Eliot Kramer <ekramer@novusbio.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 17 Jan 2027 09:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Tenant environment certification & access handoff — NovusBio

Hi Kim/David —

Thanks for the clear checklist. Attaching the requested artifacts here:
- novusbio_vpc_diagram.png (PNG) — public subnets (bastion) and private compute subnets annotated.
- novusbio_ip_allowlist.txt (TXT) — egress and ingress ACLs we control.
- novusbio_kms_policy.json (JSON) — shows that NovusBio retains sole control; we do not have a cross-account role for Redwood.
- novusbio_bastion_public_key.pub (SSH) — we will own the bastion, SSH keys managed by NovusSec.

Notes / answers to your earlier items:
- Peering approach: we prefer IPsec VPN with static routes for now; no BGP.
- NTP: we use internal NTP pool (ntp.novusbio.local). For the smoke we can allow Redwood's test IPs to hit our NTP server.
- EDR: CarbonShield (contact: j.santos@novusbio.com) — agent is deployed on all hosts and reporting to our console.
- Service account: redwood-agent@novusbio-svc (IAM role limited to KMS:Encrypt/Decrypt via our wrapper service).
- Maintenance blackout: Mon–Fri 0100–0300 UTC; avoid these windows please.

We're good to run the preflight this week; Jan 20 AM PST still works for our ops team. Please send test IPs and any temporary SSH fingerprint we should expect from your tooling.

Thanks,
Danielle Price
Site Reliability Lead
NovusBio

[Attachment stubs: novusbio_vpc_diagram.png, novusbio_ip_allowlist.txt, novusbio_kms_policy.json, novusbio_bastion_public_key.pub]
